build_note: Listed 6-5, 195 lb (Basketball-Reference; Wikipedia), No. 11 (Wikipedia); 6-3.25 wingspan at the 2019 draft combine (247Sports; NBADraft.net)
beat: Their last points of the night.
story: Milwaukee won 116–111 at Toronto to snap a 13-game losing streak, the second-longest in franchise history.
aria: Animated Short: Tyler Herro's 3-pointer with 1:03 left that made it 116–106, Milwaukee's last points in a 116–111 win at Toronto that snapped a 13-game losing streak. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
